items.title_orig: In defence of Civil War by GNR
items.article_text:
I'm sure Dave won't read this but maybe it will make its way to him somehow. On the latest ep (or two back?) Dave was dismissing Civil War by Guns N Roses - but here's the thing: it's a gateway song to bigger, better, bands with a similarly important message. I won't defend ol' Axl here at all. Even in his prime was a total diva. 
 But! For a seventeen year old kid getting into rock and metal and learning about the modern world and that history might not repeat but it definitely rhymes - stuff like feeds the rich and buries the poor is enough to make a young kid raised on Call of Duty and us military adjacent propaganda like Lone Survivor and American Sniper to go "wait a minute....what?".
 In the same way that Adam Carola and Joe Rogan are a stepping stone to Ben Shapiro and Nick Fuentes
